skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of commercial enterprise management, including market research, procurement, inventory management, sales, and customer service.
Analyze market trends and opportunities to develop effective business strategies.
Collect, analyze information, and make informed decisions in procurement and sales roles.
Demonstrate independent work and responsibility, both individually and within a team.
Develop and implement strategic plans and business operations.
Manage financial resources and costs in business operations.
Identify and manage risks in business operations.
Manage human resources effectively in business operations.
Understand and apply accounting principles and practices in business operations.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on business topics.
